description: This PHP source file defines the FISClient class in the AWS SDK for interacting with the AWS Fault Injection Simulator (FIS) service. It provides method annotations for various API calls related to experiments, configurations, and resource management within the FIS service.

classes.name: FISClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the AWS Fault Injection Simulator service, extending the base AwsClient class, with methods for managing experiments and configurations.

methods.name: createExperimentTemplate
methods.description: Creates a new Experiment Template in AWS FIS.

methods.name: createExperimentTemplateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new Experiment Template.

methods.name: getExperiment
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific experiment.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Adds tags to an AWS resource.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds tags to a resource.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from an AWS resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
